messages:
jordan: Heads-up — PR #21489 is blocked by CI. Integration shard 7 is failing with a snapshot diff on macOS-render only. Not repro'ing locally. @maria @kevin any quick eyes? Buildkite: https://buildkite.com/redwood/ci/builds/112233
ci-bot: buildkite:112233 — job failed on shard 7 — test 'render/snapshot-mac' — logs: https://logs.example.com/112233/shard7
jordan: The diff looks small, like a 1–2px shift in some glyphs. I ran the suite on my macbook and it passed, so could be infra flake or font fallback.
maria: I remember a similar one last month. Can you paste the snapshot diff snippet?
jordan: Sure — here's the relevant bit:
```
- expected pixel at (412, 210): rgba(34,34,34,255)
+ actual   pixel at (412, 211): rgba(35,35,35,255)
- baseline image hash: abc1234
+ new image hash: abd1235
```
kevin: That looks like small anti-alias / subpixel shift. Our harness is sensitive to render timing and font metrics. Two quick options: rerun the shard (targeted retry) or run with deterministic seed env (TEST_RENDER_SEED).
jordan: Can someone with retry perms do a targeted rerun on shard 7 first? If it keeps failing we'll switch to deterministic seed locally and bisect.
maria: I can trigger a targeted retry. Command I use: `bk retry --build=112233 --jobs=112233:shard7` (internal alias). Triggering now.
ci-bot: Retry requested by maria — triggered retry #2 for build 112233 (shard 7).
oncall-bot: FYI the mac-render pool had a maintenance window around 03:00 UTC and saw increased flake rate (~+12%) during that hour.
kevin: That maintenance note explains transient nondet. Good call rerunning.
maria: Retry finished — passed on retry ✅
ci-bot: buildkite:112233 (retry 2) — all tests green on shard 7, build succeeded.
jordan: Nice, thanks. I'll update the PR to mention potential font fallback nondeterminism and add an issue to track making the snapshot harness more tolerant for subpixel shifts. @sam do you still want a snapshot update pushed or should we leave as-is since rerun passed?
sam: Given the diff was tiny and we passed on retry, I'd prefer not to update snapshots blindly. If you can add a short comment in the test and an issue for follow-up, I'm comfortable approving to unblock the merge.
jordan: Added comment and created issue RNW-204: 'render snapshot nondeterminism — investigate font metrics'. Pushed a tiny test comment.
sam: I'll give this a quick review. If no other concerns, I'll approve and merge after CI green.
jordan: Thanks — CI is green now so feel free to approve.
sam: LGTM — merging once merge queue picks it up. :shipit:
ci-bot: merge-queue: PR #21489 queued for merge (merged after CI stable).
kevin: Filed a follow-up to add TEST_RENDER_SEED to our local repro docs in the repo (PR coming).
maria: Thanks everyone — good fast triage.
_meta: generated for dataset: slack threads about PR review + CI flakes; single-thread record
